newsitem.title: USA: NYSE may soon loosen sell-off circuit breakers-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: NYSE may soon loosen sell-off circuit breakers-WSJ.

text.p: Market regulators are preparing to approve the New York Stock Exchange's plan to ease the "circuit-breakers" designed to stop a panic sell-off, the Wall Street Journal said Friday.

The paper said the Chicago Mercantile Exchange received handouts stating that the changes could be approved as early as Friday and quoted people familiar with the situation as saying the changes could take effect as soon as Monday.

The changes call for stock trading to halt for 30 minutes whenever the Dow Jones Industrial Average falls 350 points during the day. If the intraday trading loss grows to 550 points after that, trading would stop for as much as an hour, the paper said.
The trigger points are presently set at 250 and 400 points.
